title: DisLeX project corpus of disaster legislation (2013-2023)

contacts.name: Egger, Clara
contacts.affiliation: Erasmus School of Social and Behavioural Sciences, Erasmus University Rotterdam

descriptions: This is the corpus of disaster legislation compiled in the context of the DisLeX project funded by an NWO XS grant (406.XS.04.112). The corpus includes disaster law collected on the IFRC Disaster Law Database (https://disasterlaw.ifrc.org/disaster-law-database).
